root_cause.text: The error unwind path in `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` incorrectly decremented the loop counter `i` twice, causing the cleanup loop to skip destroying the Work Queue (WQ) object when `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` fails, leading to a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the extra `i--` before `goto fail` in the failure branch of `mana_create_wq_obj()`, and adds a call to `mana_destroy_wq_obj()` when `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` fails. This corrects the double decrement that previously prevented the WQ object from being cleaned up.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix cleanup index in RSS QP creation error path by removing incorrect decrement of loop variable before jumping to fail label.
intent_record.what: Removed the decrement of loop variable i and its associated comment inside the error handling block of mana_create_wq_obj call in mana_ib_create_qp_rss, and simplified the if block to a single goto statement.
intent_record.how: When mana_create_wq_obj fails, the code now jumps directly to the fail label without decrementing i first. Previously, i was decremented before the jump, which altered the index used for cleanup in the fail handler. The change ensures that cleanup starts from the current index i (the failed one) instead of i-1.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing WQ object cleanup when installing CQ callback fails during RSS QP creation.
intent_record.what: Added a call to mana_destroy_wq_obj(mpc, GDMA_RQ, wq->rx_object) in the error handling block when mana_ib_install_cq_cb fails.
intent_record.how: Prevents resource leak by destroying the work queue object before jumping to the fail label, ensuring proper cleanup on error.

candidates.rationale: This statement decrements the loop counter i before jumping to the fail label. The decrement causes the cleanup loop to start from an incorrect index, skipping the Work Queue object created in the current iteration when the subsequent mana_ib_install_cq_cb() call fails. This results in a resource leak of the WQ object.
